human_made_evidence: Sketchfab Terms (effective 2026-08-12) oblige uploaders to tag redistributable models created with generative AI as "CreatedWithAI" (required for CC-licensed uploads since 2023-03-23, for all models since 2025-12-11; Sketchfab may auto-label AI-integration uploads). bulk_download: No bulk archive. Per model via the Download API (GET https://api.sketchfab.com/v3/models/{uid}/download, OAuth2 user token; glTF/GLB/USDZ only, source formats only through the website). Sketchfab Terms forbid "collect, aggregate, mine, scrape" User Content to make it available to others "except where explicitly allowed"; Download API guidelines require end-user Sketchfab login unless Sketchfab agrees otherwise. So StudPilot may not mirror these models in its own library without a written arrangement; per-user OAuth download is the allowed route.
free_tier_only_note: All free; no paid tier involved. Spot check 2026-10-07: 96 lowpoly results (newest + most liked) scanned for AI-tool words (Meshy, Tripo, Hunyuan, Rodin, "generated", "the image depicts"...): 2 keyword hits to review by hand, one from 2019 (pre-generative-3D). Unfiltered CC-BY results by relevance are dominated by AI uploads (e.g. "Meshy robot", "The image depicts a cartoon..."), so is_ai=false is mandatory. Licence does not clear third-party IP: the pool includes fan remakes (logos, game characters, real people), which must be screened out.
bulk_download: No bulk archive. Per model via the Download API (GET https://api.sketchfab.com/v3/models/{uid}/download, OAuth2 user token; glTF/GLB/USDZ only, source formats only through the website). Sketchfab Terms forbid "collect, aggregate, mine, scrape" User Content to make it available to others "except where explicitly allowed"; Download API guidelines require end-user Sketchfab login unless Sketchfab agrees otherwise. So StudPilot may not mirror these models in its own library without a written arrangement; per-user OAuth download is the allowed route.
free_tier_only_note: All free; no paid tier involved. Fab transition: Sketchfab Store closed 2024-10-22 when Fab launched; Fab accepts free CC-BY migrations but not CC0/SA/NC/ND; Epic said Sketchfab downloads stay until a viable alternative exists. On 2026-08-10 Epic sold Sketchfab and ArtStation to KitBash (Fab stays with Epic); KitBash states no changes to access or workflows, and free downloads still work on 2026-10-07 (KitBash SF Operations LLC terms effective 2026-08-12).
